paragraphs.text: Castle Melmereth (MEL-muh-reth ) was Adam Carthalion's castle in Ephren on Corondor ( Dominaria ) until the year 1265 according to the Reckoning of the Sages of Minorad .

After Adam was killed in the Battle of Aster Fall , the Planeswalker Ravidel took residence in the castle. It was destroyed after Jared Carthalion and Yorgo infiltrated the castle and Jared summoned a Shivan Dragon . Its perilous dungeons yet contain untold treasures.
